tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: App background behind everything. A neutral cool grey from the brand plate, taken almost to black. The night theme is pure black so an idle screen leaks no light.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background inside the scroll area. Carries ink-100, ink-200 and ink-300 at 4.5:1 or better in all three themes.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Card and bottom-nav background. The default ground for Card, and the tightest contrast case: every ink and signal token is checked against this one.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Pressed and selected states, table header rows, text inputs sitting on surface-200.

tokens.name: border-100
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines between rows, around inputs and around cards. Lighter than a hairline usually is, on purpose: it clears 3:1 against surface-200 in all three themes (3.4, 3.0, 3.1), so the same token can be an input border without a second, stronger one.

tokens.name: ink-100
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-100 and surface-200. Every screen title and card body uses this.

tokens.name: ink-200
tokens.usage: Secondary text: card subtitles, helper text under inputs, inactive bottom-nav labels.

tokens.name: ink-300
tokens.usage: Lowest readable text: caption eyebrows, field labels and timestamps on surface-100 or surface-200. Never below 12px and never on surface-300.

tokens.name: brand-500
tokens.usage: The Iqarus orange, sampled from the supplied mark. Fills only: the primary action, the active bottom-nav pill, the step badge. It is never the ink of running text, and in the night theme it drops to a deep red-orange that keeps the fill dark.

tokens.name: brand-600
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a brand-500 fill. Deliberately only one step darker, because ink-on-brand must still clear 4.5:1 while a thumb is down.

tokens.name: brand-400
tokens.usage: The orange as text: inline links, the active bottom-nav label, completed step marks. Lighter than brand-500 on dark grounds and much darker on white, because an orange that works as a fill fails as ink.

tokens.name: ink-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-500, brand-600 and any signal fill. Near-black, not white: white on the brand orange reaches only 3.3:1, this reaches 5.6:1 on brand-500, 4.6:1 on brand-600 and 5.1:1 on a critical fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px focus-visible outline, at a 2px offset, on every interactive element. Neutral on purpose, so it stays visible on a brand-500 fill as well as on a card.

tokens.name: brand-grey
tokens.usage: The flat plate the supplied logo is reversed out of, sampled from the file. Used only behind that raster mark, and retired once a transparent logo replaces it. Same value in every theme: a brand colour does not re-theme.

tokens.name: signal-critical
tokens.usage: Massive haemorrhage, a wrong answer, a tourniquet past its limit. It neighbours the brand orange in hue, so it is never used as a fill for an action and never appears without a word or an icon.

tokens.name: signal-warn
tokens.usage: Caution: a tourniquet past its first alert interval, a question timer under ten seconds. Separated from brand-500 and signal-critical by lightness, which survives the night theme.

tokens.name: signal-ok
tokens.usage: Correct answer, completed step, saved record. The one token whose hue is far from the brand, and the lightest of the three signals in every theme.

tokens.name: fill-critical
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind a critical card or a wrong-answer review row. Dark enough to carry both ink-100 and signal-critical at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: fill-ok
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind a correct-answer row. Carries signal-ok and ink-100.

tokens.name: overlay-600
tokens.usage: Scrim behind the tourniquet alert sheet, or any modal.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: One per screen, set in upper case, inside the sticky header.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Card titles and step headings inside a screen.

styles.name: mode-label
styles.usage: The label on a large home-screen mode button, upper case.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body text, card copy and quiz option text. Nothing a student reads while kneeling over a manikin goes below 16px.
styles.sample: Apply a CAT high and tight over the clothing.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy, and the label of a filled button.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text under an input, common-mistake lines, scenario feedback.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Upper-case eyebrows and field labels, in ink-300.

styles.name: clock-xl
styles.usage: The running tourniquet clock. Tabular digits, so the width never jumps as it counts.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: A second or third tourniquet clock in a list, and the per-question countdown.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Scores, counts and elapsed times on the Progress page.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Screen gutters are space-4 at 360px and space-5 from 600px up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked lines in one block, such as a title and its subtitle.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of a compact row, and the gap between quiz options.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, and the screen gutter on a 360px phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards, the screen gutter from 600px up, and the logo clear space.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on one screen.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above a destructive action, and the bottom pad that clears BottomNav.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and option rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and the large home-screen mode buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Step dots, the tourniquet count badge, and both ends of a progress bar.

size.note: Touch targets come from this family, never from a padding guess.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable, icon-only buttons included. No exceptions.

tokens.name: tap-lg
tokens.usage: Height of a primary action and of a quiz option row.

tokens.name: tap-xl
tokens.usage: Height of a home-screen mode button and of the tourniquet START control.

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: Height of BottomNav, not counting the safe-area inset it adds below itself.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a screen content column; it centres above that width.

tokens.name: logo-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the full Iqarus lockup. Below this the strapline stops being legible and the wordmark is used alone.

shadow.note: Elevation is carried by surface steps and hairlines. A shadow appears only where something floats over scrolling content.

tokens.name: shadow-nav
tokens.usage: Under BottomNav and under a sticky screen header.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The tourniquet alert sheet, and any modal.
